notes.title: Update V1.3.0 & ディスカウント開始
notes.content:
Dear players, after several updates and optimizations, our 'Voice Love on Air' is now available at a discount once again in its best form. For those who have been waiting for a discount and optimizations, now is the perfect time to grab it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321120/_Voice_Love_on_Air/

A new feature "Guidance Manual" is now available! In "Voice Actors' Profile", players now can open "Guidance Manual" to view key event guidance for the main characters.

[olist]
[*] Guidance Manual has been added, players can view key event guidance for main characters.
[*] CGs, transitions, and message scenes can now also be sped up: Hold "Ctrl" to fast forward; press "F" or click Skip to skip the performance.
[*] Optimized English localization.
[*] Improved controller operations for message scenes.
[*] Fixed the problem of abnormal triggering of some events.
[*] Fixed the problem that the virtual keyboard would not automatically open on Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed resolution settings problem on Steam Deck.
[*] Corrected some text errors.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update V1.1.6 Optimization of Studio Visiting and Personal Side Storyline Event
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Added a speed option for daily scheduled animation in SETTING.
[*] Added an option in SETTING to disable Studio Visiting Event.
[*] Adjusted the probability of Studio Visiting Event and increased the favorability rewards for these events.
[*] When starting a new game from a playthrough save file, more content will be inherited: money, attributes, voice actor information. (The additional inherited content will only be available when starting a new game from a completed save file.)
[*] When acquiring new items, relevant prompts will appear in the STUDIO INFO.
[*] Added exclamation point prompts on the world map for certain personal side storyline events.
[*] Corrected typos.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update V1.1.5 Game Experience Optimization & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed some character map event trigger issues.
[*] Fixed trigger issues with certain scheduling events.
[*] Corrected some typos.
[*] Fixed display issues with constellation icons.
[*] The maximum number of save files has now been increased to 50.
[*] Dialogues in mini-games can now be skipped more quickly.
[*] Optimized some UI effects.
[*] Added branching options after the September social media event. If no one has been romanced, players can choose to directly start the second playthrough or continue to complete individual endings.
[*] After the September social media event, regardless of the reason for game failure, players can inherit gameplay data and start a second playthrough.
[*] 
[*] Events featuring the addition of all voice actors now include exclamation point prompts on the main map.
[*] Fixed issues where certain plot music did not trigger correctly.
[*] 
[*] Fixed issues where voice director skills may not be obtainable in multiple playthroughs.
[*] During table read, prompts for directions unlocked during voice broadcasts will now appear on options.
[/olist]

notes.title: Let's become sound directors! The DEMO version is now online!
notes.content:
After two weeks since the release of the first trailer, we apologize for the long wait!

[h3]The DEMO for 'Voice Love on Air,' a boys' love audio broadcast, is finally online![/h3]

The five characters previously revealed—Aki, Wesley, Ryousei, Junichi, and Yuuki —will all make appearances.

You can experience the recording of the first radio drama in the game, freely choose your favorite actors, and perform different voices. Each recording will bring a completely new experience!

The release date is approaching, so if you enjoy playing, please remember to add 'Voice Love on Air' to your wishlist.

notes.content:

At the end of February, we'll first release a demo for everyone to try out. Please continue to support us and add the game to your wishlists!
